_README: Every number the app uses to compute money or time lives here — nothing is
hardcoded in the engine. Edit this file and restart kakis; no code deploy.
These are PILOT ESTIMATES for illustration, not billed rates. Billing runs
through the Vanguard / ICCP account during the pilot. Each value carries a
'source' so the coordinator can see where it came from and challenge it.
Anything with source 'PLACEHOLDER' has not been confirmed with Vanguard or
MOH and should be treated as a guess.

Chaperone.source: PLACEHOLDER — pilot estimate, not confirmed with Vanguard
Chaperone.note: Accompanying to appointments; longest typical visit because of travel and waiting.

Companionship.source: PLACEHOLDER — pilot estimate, not confirmed with Vanguard
Companionship.note: Conversation, a walk, a meal together. No personal-care tasks.

Wellness check.source: PLACEHOLDER — pilot estimate, not confirmed with Vanguard
Wellness check.note: Short drop-in to confirm the senior is safe and well.

Household help.source: PLACEHOLDER — pilot estimate, not confirmed with Vanguard
Household help.note: Light housekeeping, laundry, simple meal prep.

community_care_fund_pct.source: PLACEHOLDER — illustrative means-tested rate, NOT an MOH-confirmed figure
community_care_fund_pct.note: Applied to the base cost before the family's share is calculated. Real subsidy is means-tested per household and will vary widely.

foundation_topup_pct.note: Represents a charitable top-up covering part of the remainder. Not yet committed by any funder.

transport_allowance_per_visit.source: PLACEHOLDER — approx. two-way public transport within Pasir Ris
transport_allowance_per_visit.note: Flat per visit regardless of distance during the pilot.

hours_are_estimates.note: Visit hours come from the service defaults above, not from measured start/end timestamps. Impact and earnings totals therefore ESTIMATE effort rather than measure it.

default_hours_when_service_unknown.note: Fallback used when a visit references a service missing from this file.

urgent_response_target_minutes.note: What 'Urgent — within the hour' promises the family.

half_day_windows.note: Availability is captured in half-days, not exact hours, to keep it realistic for part-time kakis.

min_visit_hours.source: Decision 2026-09-04 after the Table Top Exercise: 1-hour blocks, not a 2-hour minimum
min_visit_hours.note: Any exact-time booking shorter than this is charged as this.

rounding_hours.source: Decision 2026-09-04: prorated to the half hour at the same hourly rate
rounding_hours.note: Duration rounds UP to the nearest half hour.

disclaimer.long: Figures are pilot estimates for illustration only. Actual costs, subsidies and payouts are determined by the Vanguard / ICCP account and the applicable means test.
